standard_statement: Determine the fixed-rank adjacency graph of a growing family of finite ideals extended by m singleton continuations. Identify adjacency, finite-radius counts, scope over starting incidence systems, and failure under bounded supply.
nearest_known_result: FIRST-KNOT-20261118-001A Proposition 4 and FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001A Theorem 4. Classical unrestricted type A counts are background (Baake and Grimm 1997).
delta: The accepted proofs identify growth through all rounds. We seek adjacency and boundary terms at one rank and exact census equivalence.
decision_rule: Prove directly from the stated law. Keep exact hypotheses, initial and saturation cases. A failed generalization gives its first witness or remains an open obligation.
claim: Every admitted m and t, census reductions and cap-three parts, including the finite cutoff and the m=2 counterexample.

validation.independence: Separate same-task mathematical reviewer, two independent growth/count implementations, explicit third finite model. No external referee.
validation.authority: symbolic, uniform at fixed input assumptions
